games.name: Best Dam Game
games.description: Chew trees, throw logs, blow stuff up. Best Dam Game is co-op physics chaos for up to 4 beavers building one seriously big dam. Take the contract, beat the rising river, fire your friends out of a cannon, and hunt down some very important hats.

games.name: TrapRush
games.description: TrapRush is an online party platformer for 2 to 12 players. Each round, everyone places one item on the same course: a bridge, a spring, or a saw hidden under it. Then you all race to the flag at once. Make it while your friends don't, and you score.

games.name: $1 Pizza Slice
games.description: Run a cozy New York pizza shop where every slice costs $1. Roll dough, prepare toppings, bake and cut pizzas, then serve hungry neighbors. Shop for ingredients, upgrade your kitchen, share leftovers, and chip away at your debt one slice at a time.

games.name: Explosive Express
games.description: Explosive Express is a chaotic 1–4 player co-op physics game where tiny workers transport unstable bombs through a giant world. Work together, load the van, survive the hazards, and get the bomb home before time runs out.

games.name: Friendgeist
games.description: An online co-op horror comedy for up to 5 players. You wake up trapped in a house haunted by the Friendgeist, a spirit that takes the shape of a friend to deceive and possess you. Find the way out. If one of you gets possessed, exorcise them before it's too late. Or escape, if they let you.

games.name: Anomalous Coffee Machine 3
games.description: You're a broke freelance artist who just found a reality-bending coffee machine in your apartment stairwell. Discover anomalous drinks, dominate social media, sell your anomalous creations online, and spread the weirdness.

games.name: Make It Burn
games.description: A first-person incremental game about throwing gems into a hole. Press the buzzer, push the gems into the fire and buy machines to burn more and more. Bring the gem count on the wall down to zero to open the next room.

games.name: Build to Survive
games.description: Build a car, launch it down a mountain road and let physics decide. No steering, no second chances: pick the body, engine, suspension and tyres, then watch your machine fly, crash and fall apart. Beat gold times in Challenges or race two cars side by side in Free Drive.

games.name: Nameless Fate
games.description: Follow a bamboo path into a shared temple. Sweep leaves, meditate, strike a wooden fish, or count prayer beads. Earn incense and wish slips through practice, then light a stick or write a wish by hand as other players pass through the courtyard.

games.name: Sun Smith
games.description: Help an ancient derelict repair itself. Harvest power, mine ore, fabricate components, clone colonists, and research technologies.

games.name: Guildlands
games.description: Forge, fight and trade, together. A multiplayer idle RPG that lives on your taskbar: your hero fights, mines and fishes while you work, and every piece of gear you forge shows on them. Free to play, in a shared world where players set every price.

games.name: Pawlifters!
games.description: A 2–6 player party heist game, local or online. Cute animal thieves hide in plain sight: grab the loot and blend into the crowd. Or become the guard and whack your friends with a baton — just don’t mix them up with the visitors!

games.name: Musicality
games.description: A cozy co-op music toy. Plug synths, drums and pedals together in your own little home, record takes for the neighbours, and jam with friends over Steam.

games.name: Street Football: Foul Play
games.description: Play football with no rules, solo or with up to 4 friends in local or online co-op. Customize the weather and disasters, unleash brutal tackles and super shots on your rivals, and turn every match into total chaos!

games.name: Inside the Samosbor
games.description: A first-person co-op horror game for 1–4 players set in the world of Samosbor. Explore contaminated residential blocks, find a way out, and evade monsters and anomalies. Beware of liquidators who may mistake you for the infected. Get out alive.

games.name: Corner Quest
games.description: An idle auto-battler in the corner of your screen. Your Mage fights on her own while you work. Choose her Spells, reshape them with Forms and Runes, and fight through 50+ waves in 15 Biomes.

games.name: Tonald Dump: Make News Fake Again
games.description: Lead Tonald Dump through a satirical, turn-based presidential campaign! Manipulate the media, influence voter groups, build political connections and navigate 600+ events across four campaign stages. Control the headlines. Win the election!

games.name: One More Potato
games.description: One More Potato is a cozy organizing simulator where you sort over 2,000 potatoes into their correct places across a countryside farm. Pick up potatoes, complete collections, unlock helpful upgrades, and turn a messy farm into a perfectly organized potato paradise, solo or with friends.

games.name: Carrot Planet
games.description: An entire planet of carrots to harvest. Team up with up to 16 players online, pick carrots, drive vehicles, automate everything, and befriend the locals. Build a massive carrot empire together in this cozy incremental automation life sim!

games.name: Luck and Raid
games.description: A 1–4 player online co-op, top-down action RPG/roguelike where luck is everything. You're fluffy, and you're adorable. Earn money and get stronger. Running low on cash? Try gambling! Lost it all? Just borrow some from a friend. Your friend is broke too? Congratulations! Now the real co-op begins.

games.name: Sorted by Christmas
games.description: It’s almost Christmas and there’s a mountain of 100,000 presents still to sort. Round up your Gonk Squad for first-person co-op chaos with vacuums, black holes and Festive Dynamite. Up to 8 players, or solo.

games.name: Overcharge
games.description: Overcharge is a chaotic 2-4 player co-op platformer where holding the Energy Core for too long gets your team wiped. Catch and pass the core as you run, jump, and dodge through deadly obstacle courses. Climb the Ascension spires, overcome the Gauntlet, or build your own maps in Creative mode.

games.name: Starfuse
games.description: A cozy fireworks incremental where your upgrade tree is the night sky. Set your Shell Rack, pop drifting wish lanterns and chain bursts that relight the stars. Every place adds its own rule and a new toy, from lighthouse beams to storm clouds, until you can rekindle the dead Sun.

games.name: Saw Down
games.description: Turn a tiny robot with a saw into a machine that grinds through mountains of scrap. Gather resources, choose your upgrades, and unleash explosions, flying sawblades, and chain lightning. Grow stronger with every haul and cut your way deeper.

games.name: Put Out The Sun
games.description: Put Out The Sun is a co-op incremental game about one ridiculous job: extinguishing a star. Spit, spray and haul water as a crew of four-armed aliens, mine ice, build conveyor lines and turrets, and automate everything until the Sun finally goes dark. Play solo or with up to 6 friends.

games.name: Apartment Empire
games.description: Build your own apartment empire, one floor at a time. Design flats, collect rent, manage tenants with very different needs, and try to keep everyone happy. Meet colourful characters, uncover their stories, and discover that some residents are not entirely from around here.

games.name: Fire Up the Stadium
games.description: Fire Up the Stadium is an incremental restoration game where you bring a massive stadium back to its former glory. Restore faded seats, earn money, unlock powerful tools and upgrades, and build automated restoration machines. The more seats you restore, the faster and more powerful you become!

games.name: Just! Yell! FireBall!
games.description: Turn your voice into magic in this chaotic online PvP party game! Shout spells into your microphone, collect magic scrolls, dodge incoming attacks, and blast your rivals away in colorful arenas. Challenge friends, other players, or bots!

games.name: Bakebound
games.description: Bakebound is a short, active incremental game about harvesting a magical field that fights back. Sweep through living crops, dodge their attacks, and bake what you gather into recipes that make every trip stronger.

games.name: Treasured Carpets
games.description: Run a cozy carpet shop in an Istanbul-style bazaar. Buy rugs, wash away dirt, scrub grime, dry the fibers, and restore faded patterns. Unfold your finds for customers, match their tastes, and turn careful restoration into a thriving little showroom.

games.name: SHOVEL BRIGADE
games.description: Shovel Brigade is a free-to-play multiplayer war sandbox. Dig trenches, build bunkers, defend your camp, and survive chaotic battles with friends. Your defenses are destructible, your orders are unpredictable, and your shovel is always ready.

games.name: One Last Fish
games.description: A cozy fishing idle game that sits anywhere on your desktop. Catch rare fish, buy upgrades and customize your island while you study, work or relax!

games.name: Arctic Shop Simulator
games.description: Run a small shop at the edge of the Arctic wilderness. Ride your snowmobile into frozen regions, track and sedate wildlife, fish, survive brutal weather, and return home to sell your finds. Negotiate with customers, expand your shop, and build a thriving business in the far north.

games.name: Chaos Conquest
games.description: Chaos Conquest is a casual incremental auto-battler set in a fantasy world. Mine gold, grow your army from a lone soldier into a mighty battalion, and watch as your soldiers defeat hordes of quirky enemies!

games.name: Sort, Spell & Meow
games.description: Have you ever seen a cozy organizing game where the items actually fly? You broke into the witch’s workshop looking for valuable artifacts, but the cat activated one of them. Now everything is floating — everything swirls around the room. Put everything back in place to find what you came for.

games.name: Rally King
games.description: Rally King is a casino-themed ping pong roguelike where every rally puts the pot on the line. Play solo or with up to 3 friends. Hit chips, collect cards, roll dice, stack multipliers, and build broken paddle combos before one bad shot wipes it all.

games.name: All Haul the King
games.description: A co-op game where you and your friends embark on an epic journey to drag the goblin king’s dead body across the kingdom to resurrect him. Use brains, brawn and crazy goblin magic to navigate the tricky terrain and puzzles that lie in your path.

games.name: Tiny Queendom: An Ant Terrarium
games.description: A living ant colony on your desktop. Build a glass terrarium of sand, water and plants, add one queen, and watch her family dig tunnels, forage, learn from danger and raise new queens on its own. Keep it in a small window in the corner of your screen while you work.

games.name: Sol Mates
games.description: Blast and laugh your way through space with up to 4 friends in this chaotic roguelike co-op. Every run is a new adventure so steer, shield, and work together to take on unpredictable challenges - or at least go out in style.

games.name: CTRL+ALT+BURN
games.description: Keep the company online. Avoid the boss. CTRL+ALT+BURN is a chaotic co-op IT game for 1 to 6 players: reboot crashed servers, swap dead disks, answer the helpdesk, put out the microwave fire and climb a 60-floor office tower, one shift at a time.

games.name: Pixel Life
games.description: Move to the cozy pixel town of Pinewood and build a life from scratch. Land a job and climb the career ladder, cook, fish, paint, make friends and fall in love, all while keeping your needs up and making rent every Monday. Chase your dream, one day at a time.

games.name: Secret of Nox
games.description: Immerse yourself in this action roguelike game, turn defeated enemies into your minions. Explore 12+ unique classes, endless playstyles, battle through 50+ maps, epic bosses and discover the Secret of Nox.

games.name: The Last Coin
games.description: Bet your soul against other players in a casino you can't escape. Take turns dropping coins into a glass of whiskey about to overflow, keep your hand steady and cheat with items. Whoever overflows it loses their soul.

games.name: Bad Call
games.description: Bad Call is a social game for 3-6 players set in an underground bunker. You're locked in separate rooms. Win challenges, trade code digits, forge alliances, and lie over the phone. Everyone needs the same exit code, but not everyone will escape.

games.name: Wisps & Wares: A Spirit of the North Idler
games.description: Return to the enchanting world of Spirit of the North in a cozy shopkeeping idler. Send your Fox Guardian exploring, gather treasures, stock the Raccoon’s traveling shop, and journey across the Northern Isles in charming pixel art.

games.name: Poutamelo
games.description: Create your own music and share your finished sheet music with the townspeople. Then, visit the local live music bar to hear them perform your songs. Help out with farming, get to know your neighbors, and create your own story in a peaceful little town in this life simulation game.

games.name: Chain Detonator
games.description: Set mines, lure robots into your trap and trigger explosive chain reactions—then escape the blast. A top-down action-puzzle game with 50 campaign levels, solo challenges, local PvP for 2–4 players and online PvP for up to 16 on dedicated servers.

games.name: Mall Security
games.description: Co-op physics comedy for 1–4 mall guards. X-ray shoppers, yell orders into your mic, chase shoplifters and throw them in the cell. Every broken window goes on your report, so try not to get fired. Or switch sides in Thieves vs Guards PvP.

games.name: It Works: Electronics Repair Simulator - First Short Circuit
games.description: Take your first steps in the electronics repair business! Enter your home garage, master the basics of diagnostics, use the multimeter, and solve your very first hardware crises. Fix basic devices, satisfy your clients, and face the ultimate test: your first short circuit!

games.name: MOONWRIGHT
games.description: A lunar mining sim where the time lag is part of the game. Age of a new Gold Rush started and you are one of the first prospectors on the Moon. Drive a rover, find and mine lunar ores and sell what you mined. Use money to upgrade rover and Moon base. Receive new missions and try your luck there.

games.name: Mop & Plot
games.description: Clock in, clean up, and watch your back: in this chaotic online social deduction game for up to 12 players, paint walls, scrub floors, and finish the job while hidden Saboteurs wreak havoc. Use proximity voice chat to spot the culprits and vote them out!

games.name: The Perfect Quest: The Drowned King's Hoard
games.description: A text adventure inspired by the Sierra classics. A pirate with a hat and no ship, a sarcastic parrot and a map torn in three: type your way across the Caribbean, dig up chests, forge papers, bribe a skeleton with a fish and out-fence your old captain to a legendary hoard.

games.name: Leaf to Sun
games.description: Autumn is ending, and the sun grows weaker by the day. Blow fallen leaves into the bonfire to grow the fire, and power up your wind and flames with the skill tree. Before long, the journey heads to space. A relaxing pixel-art incremental game.

games.name: Roads & Riches: Traveling Merchant Simulator
games.description: Hit the road and set up shop, solo or with friends! Take your caravan wherever demand leads, sell wonderful wares, and find magical treasures - all to win over the hearts, minds, and wallets of a vast, dynamic world!

games.name: Kibble Rescue
games.description: A cozy first-person cleanup game. The shop cats tore open a giant bag of pet food and buried Happy Paws Pet Shop under a million kibbles. Scoop it up, pack it into crates, wrap and ship the boxes, buy bigger tools, and put every product back on its shelf before closing time.

games.name: STICKMAN DESKTOP MALWARS
games.description: A physics stickman brawler on a living computer desktop. The taskbar is the floor, windows are platforms and every app opens a new arena. Brawl as eight ragdoll fighters, each with their own attacks, or be the giant mouse cursor: charge a RAM, run VirusGuard on them and open a black hole.

games.name: Living With Dad - Family Party
games.description: Take on the Championn’Appart challenge with Dad’s Girls in this colourful party game! Who will take the top spot on the podium?

games.name: Sitry & Chami Desktop Pet
games.description: Meet Sitry & Chami, your adorable hand-painted gouache desktop companions! Watch them climb active windows, dangle their legs from title bars, play bongo drums to your keyboard typing, and hilariously prank your screen with paint splatters and squeaky hammers.

games.name: Clara Wraiths 3
games.description: Clara Wraiths 3 is a 2D top-down survival horror game based on the story of a psychic, called Clara, who investigates the various haunted locations in the US in order to help the spirits move on or find peace.

games.name: Charmosaic
games.description: Relax with Charmosaic, a cozy, free-to-play diamond painting game. Match colors, place thousands of tiny diamonds, and watch beautiful pictures come to life. Choose from three difficulty levels and enjoy new free paintings every month.
